purpose: Public names of the llm_kit pipeline products and supervised jobs, with their lifecycle status. Pipeline names adapt content-pipeline-kit's contract; removed entries keep the content-pipeline-kit release that removed them. Removed entries for cli.bulk are not carried (llm_kit has no module of that name). Supervised jobs add the package-native surface introduced in 1.6.0.

entries.name: llm_kit.pipeline.runtime.backends.BACKEND_ENV
entries.replacement: CONTENT_PIPELINE_LLM_MODELS (backends.MODELS_ENV); route() and routed_model() read it. The old CONTENT_PIPELINE_LLM_BACKEND/_MODEL/_ENDPOINT triple is refused by route().

entries.name: llm_kit.pipeline.runtime.budget.guarded_sweep
entries.replacement: The tracked run path (llm_kit.pipeline.execution); a caller that only needs a loop catches llm_kit.pipeline.runtime.budget.BudgetStop itself.

entries.name: llm_kit.pipeline.execution.adapter.RunAdapter.reconcile
entries.replacement: None. finalize_run re-applies every accepted unit whose last apply attempt is not APPLY_SUCCEEDED or APPLY_REJECTED, so apply must be repeat-safe; drop the reconcile argument.
